title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
note: The tested DXGI loader route stopped at DX12 error 0x80004004. Removing the loader allowed gameplay but lost OptiScaler upscaling and did not confirm FG. Alternate loader selection requires a fresh game check.
observed: DXGI loader caused DX12 startup error on tested build; bypass reached gameplay without confirmed FG, October 29, 2026
